notes: Historical winter motorsport oval on the Ramenskoe hippodrome. The hippodrome operator documents annual winter car races from 1997 to 2011. The municipal report identifies the 1,600 m ice oval and 16 m width. Independent 2025 satellite imagery supplies the permanent oval footprint; temporary snow/ice racing-line alignment is unverified and remains a draft. The unrelated northern sports track and inner field are excluded. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1538.7 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
